text: Vaco has a client in Absecon that is looking for a property accountant with strong financial reporting skills and some accounting experience with affordable multifamily properties. Any experience with industry software like Yardi or RealPage is preferred, and strong Excel skills are required. This is a hybrid role and a chance to join an industry leading company that is looking to grow and expand their portfolio.
